notes.title: The Next Fest Update
notes.content:
Hello all, September has been a busy month for us and Top Gnome as we have been gearing up for Steam Next Fest this October! We've been pushing hard to get Top Gnome demo ready for you all to finally play. We've been itching (Bert included) to see what everyone thinks, and we want to hear feedback on your experience with Top Gnome's Demo.

We have also decided to introduce a new mechanic called Trinkets to spice things up. Trinkets can be bought from the shop for cheap, and give unique bonuses that can be upgraded if you can find and catch the illusive Rosetta Scarabs. While you only start with one trinket slot, you will be able to unlock more as you play through the game.

Overall this month has been incredibly productive and while we wait for Next Fest, here is a summary of what got done this month (We may have forgotten to list some things):
[list]
[*] Added a new trinket system that will give bonuses depending on what you choose to equip
[*] Added a menu to list all the new trinkets
[*] You can now cycle through potions you pick up
[*] Shop now has full functionality
[*] Button prompts will now show up over their corresponding actions, and will match your key bind settings and controller type
[*] Added potion and button drops from enemies
[*] Added Rosetta Scarabs
[*] Re-balanced the difficulty of early-mid waves
[*] The map and bullet select screen got a makeover
[*] The game now concludes at wave 15
[*] Added a continue feature that will save your progress from an unfinished run
[*] A whole bunch of polish with both menus and in-game
[*] Lots of bug fixes (They never end)
[*] Small performance improvements (Ongoing process)
[/list]

That about wraps up this month's update. There is still tons of work we need to do to get things ready, so we need to get back on top of that.

Make sure to join the discord if you haven't already!
https://discord.gg/e3gqFUaSJa

notes.title: The potions update
notes.content:
Another month, another update!

This month has been focused primarily on the content and meat of the game, as well as little bits of polish that makes the game feel good to play. We added several new bullet types and are about a third of the way through adding in potions and their effects. What's a potion you may ask?

Well, potions in Top Gnome serve as the game's powerups. As you play through the game and collect the game's currency (Buttons!), you will be able to buy these powerups as well as the different types of bullets. We wanted each potion to have a unique effect that makes them stand out from one another, and hold the design philosophy that potions must give back some form of control back to the player given the game's mechanics. If you want to see how the shop looks, you can look back to our previous monthly update to see the shop art!

Here are some of the new potions we've been working on:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360549/74a6c622dd0b26bf093a62050f7d1e0258fc3445.png[/img]
[i]We don't know why there is a fishing pole, but the shopkeeper insisted on it being a potion?[/i]

Join the discord! Bert will heroically pose for your garden if you do!
https://discord.gg/e3gqFUaSJa

notes.title: The controller update
notes.content:
Menus, menus, menus... Does any one even like menu and UI/UX work?
Almost squashed all the bugs in the menus, we now have full controller support, new songs on the way, and most menu features are in now like the playlist and key binds.

For my fellow PlayStation controller users, yes you have PS icons, no stinking X Box icons for us here! 
(XBox icons are also available for those of you that use an XBox controller, don't worry, you wont suffer like us PS controller users did.)

notes.title: April Update
notes.content:
Do you hear that? We do, sounds are coming back to Top Gnome! Aside from a couple things, the port is caught up to where we were in Unity.
That's the good news... the bad news, is that day jobs make everything slower, especially when they increase your hours.
So we may be slower but we are still plugging along.
New better nature sounds are about to be recorded, as well as some more SFX for the world, music is getting added again, and the playlist system is almost up and running.

Don't forget to wishlist us and join the discord! Get your records and lets play some music!
https://discord.gg/e3gqFUaSJa
